hero_subtitle: An interactive tool for solving linear systems, interpolation, and root finding.
how_to_desc: This platform provides computational tools for numerical analysis. The architecture automatically discovers and registers new methods.
step1: Select a method from the sidebar navigation panel. Use the search bar or browse by numerical category.
step2: Review the theoretical instructions on each method's page to format your inputs correctly.
step3: Input your parameters and execute to obtain the algorithmic step-by-step resolution.
tip: 💡 TIP: The method registry dynamically loads new algorithms as they are implemented in the backend.
error_fill_fields: Fill in all the matrix and vector fields first.
error_fill_points: Please input valid numerical coordinates for all nodes (x, y).
error_fill_x_eval: Please provide a valid x value for polynomial evaluation.
error_duplicate_x: The abscissas (x) must be pairwise distinct. Duplicate value x = {x} found at nodes {i} and {j}.
expr_hint: Available: sin, cos, tan, exp, log, sqrt, abs, pi, e
history_empty: No calculations yet — go try a method!
plotter_desc: Plot independent mathematical functions or discrete data points without running a specific method.
plotter_points_hint: Enter one pair per line, separated by a comma.
plotter_placeholder: Configure parameters on the left to generate a plot.
